description: Check a spend before your payment service is called: per-payment and daily limits, blocked categories, a merchant allow-list and an approval threshold, plus a Caelara Shield screen of the merchant domain. Returns allow, escalate (with a single-use human approval) or block, plain-English reasons and a signed, hash-only clearance receipt. It verifies spend rules only: it never pays, never moves money and never takes card numbers or wallet addresses (0.025 USDC per call). Heuristic screening — will miss attacks.

amount.description: Amount about to be spent, greater than 0

currency.description: ISO 4217 code such as USD, or a short asset symbol

destination_hash.description: Or the SHA-256 of the destination, computed by you (64 hex)

merchant_domain.description: Merchant domain, e.g. shop.example.com (send this or destination_hash)
